candidates.name: LLSS production deterministic rules
candidates.rationale: Actual shipped implementation and non-negotiable structured-identifier floor.

candidates.name: LLSS production rules plus name heuristic
candidates.rationale: Actual shipped local fallback including contextual-name heuristic.

candidates.name: Rampart MiniLM browser PII detector
candidates.rationale: Small browser-native ONNX artifact with a published deterministic companion layer.

candidates.name: Masker Mini v3
candidates.rationale: PII-specific 35.4M-parameter model with an INT4 ONNX deployment artifact.

candidates.name: DataFog PII EN 71M (legacy checkpoint)
candidates.rationale: Broad 41-label taxonomy is attractive, but the pinned repository declares a custom pii_ner architecture without publishing the executable model implementation needed for a reproducible run.

candidates.name: DataFog PII EN 65M
candidates.rationale: Reproducible standard token-classification checkpoint; narrow seven-label coverage provides a useful architecture control.

candidates.name: Gravitee BERT Small PII
candidates.rationale: Quantized ONNX exists and training includes semi-structured document formats.

candidates.name: Desert Ant Labs Redact
candidates.rationale: Promising multilingual LiteRT detector, but distribution is source-available rather than open-source and the repository's PyTorch fallback is pickle-only. Requires licence review and a dedicated LiteRT adapter; unsafe deserialisation is prohibited.

candidates.name: AI4Privacy English anonymiser
candidates.rationale: PII-specific model trained on the OpenPII label family.

candidates.name: Piiranha v1
candidates.rationale: Popular PII-specific accuracy control; licence blocks extension distribution.

candidates.name: NVIDIA GLiNER PII
candidates.rationale: Broad PII/PHI model paired with a 55-plus-category synthetic dataset.

candidates.name: Knowledgator GLiNER PII Edge
candidates.rationale: Edge-sized open-label PII/PHI/PCI detector with ONNX variants.

candidates.name: Knowledgator GLiNER PII Small
candidates.rationale: Small open-label model permits direct probing of the complete LLSS taxonomy.

candidates.name: GLiNER Small PII
candidates.rationale: Broad explicit PII and medical label coverage; large artifact is a deployment concern.

candidates.name: Gretel GLiNER Bi Small
candidates.rationale: PII/PHI open-label accuracy control trained on Gretel synthetic data.

candidates.name: Scotoma Small clinical PHI
candidates.rationale: Quantized clinical de-identification control; custom ONNX adapter pending.

candidates.name: Microsoft Presidio with spaCy English
candidates.rationale: Widely used rules-plus-NER control, useful even if not browser-deployable as-is.

candidates.name: BERT base generic NER
candidates.rationale: Generic NER control quantifies how much PII-specific training contributes.

candidates.name: Perplexity PII Masking 0.6B
candidates.rationale: Large conversational accuracy control; custom code and size make it unsuitable for default shipping.

candidates.name: OpenMed Privacy Filter Nemotron v2
candidates.rationale: High-capacity health-domain control, not a realistic extension payload.
